## ✅ Foods to Emphasise

1. **Bitter gourd (karela)** — naturally helps lower blood sugar
2. **Fenugreek seeds (methi)** — improves insulin sensitivity
3. **Amla (Indian gooseberry)** — antioxidants, Vitamin C
4. **Drumstick leaves (moringa)** — anti-diabetic properties
5. **Brown rice & millets** (jowar, bajra, ragi) — low GI grains
6. **Cinnamon** — may improve insulin sensitivity
7. **Jamun (Indian blackberry)** — traditional blood sugar support
8. **Chickpeas & lentils** — high fibre, slow glucose release
9. **Leafy greens** (spinach, fenugreek) — magnesium-rich
10. **Chia seeds** — fibre and omega-3

---

## 🚫 Foods to Limit / Avoid

- **White rice** — replace with brown rice or millets
- **Maida** (refined flour) products — white bread, samosas, etc.
- **Fruit juices** — high glycaemic, drink whole fruit instead
- **Potatoes** — high GI; use sweet potato sparingly
- **Sugary drinks** — sodas, packaged juices, chai with sugar
- **Fried foods** — puri, bhature, pakoras
- **Full-fat dairy in excess**
- **Processed sugar** — use stevia or dates sparingly

---

## 💧 Hydration Guide

| Time | Recommendation |
|------|---------------|
| Morning (wake up) | 2 glasses warm water with lemon |
| Before meals | 1 glass water (30 min before each meal) |
| Mid-morning | 1 glass coconut water (unsweetened) |
| Evening | Herbal tea (cinnamon or green tea) |
| **Total daily target** | **2.5–3 litres** |

---

## 🌿 Lifestyle Tips

1. **Eat every 3–4 hours** — prevents blood sugar crashes
2. **Portion control** — use a smaller plate; fill half with vegetables
3. **Walk after meals** — 10–15 minutes post-meal walk significantly improves glucose
4. **Check labels** — avoid hidden sugars in "health" products
5. **Monitor blood sugar** — log meals and glucose readings to identify triggers
6. **Sleep well** — poor sleep worsens insulin resistance
7. **Stress management** — cortisol raises blood glucose; try yoga or meditation
